title: Réflexes balistiques
approval_scope: Full displayed RP, additive projectile-dodge current/next values and limitation to projectiles resolved by an accuracy check accepted as provisional balance. Unshown full curves, projectile taxonomy, detailed stacking/hit cases and native visuals remain pending.
accepted_conditions: Bonus added to ordinary dodge only against projectiles using an accuracy/hit check.
unshown_rules_approval: Full rank curves, ordinary dodge/hit bounds, physical/magical projectile taxonomy, pellets/rays/multiple-hit and area component eligibility, additive stacking with other dodge effects and attribute/implant/equipment interactions remain pending where not already accepted. No automatic miss, invulnerability, projectile reflection, area damage resistance or new hit check for automatic effects introduced.
